notes.title: Kickstarter for Free Stars: Children of Infinity
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Days and Jubilation![/h1]

On April 16th, we launched our Kickstarter for [i][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pistolshrimp/free-stars-children-of-infinity]Free Stars: Children of Infinity[/url][/i], and within just over 3 hours, it was fully funded!

Our Kickstarter still has several stretch goals to go, from adding voice acting all the way up to completely open-sourcing the entire game and engine. Along the way, there are plenty of digital and physical collectors' goodies for fans of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645580/Free_Stars_The_UrQuan_Masters/]The Ur-Quan Masters[/url] to enjoy.

If you haven't already, check out our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pistolshrimp/free-stars-children-of-infinity]Kickstarter[/url] and help us make the best version of this game we can.

Thank you, and don't forget to *enjoy the sauce*.
